description: This source file defines serialization and copying logic for the ImmutableQueue<T> collection in Orleans, including a serializer, a surrogate type, and a deep copier.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer class for ImmutableQueue<T>, converting to and from a surrogate.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type used during serialization to hold the list of values.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier class for ImmutableQueue<T>, supporting deep cloning with cycle detection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate object back into an ImmutableQueue<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableQueue<T> into its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableQueue<T>, utilizing a copier for element type T.
